body: Symptom: Electron window flashes open then hides/closes. Cause #1 (primary): createWindow() held the BrowserWindow only in a function-local 'const win' — after the function returns, no reference is retained, V8 GCs the object and Electron destroys the OS window (classic documented Electron bug). Fix: module-level 'let win: BrowserWindow|null' + win.on('closed',()=>win=null). Cause #2: backgroundColor '#00000000' + vibrancy 'under-window' + visualEffectState + body background:transparent rendered an invisible/transparent window. Fix: opaque backgroundColor #ffffff, body background var(--background), drop vibrancy/transparent (kept titleBarStyle hiddenInset — safe). Added 3s show-fallback if ready-to-show never fires. RULE: every Electron BrowserWindow MUST be held in a module/global reference for its lifetime; never rely on transparent+vibrancy for a primary window without an opaque fallback.
title: apps/desktop window opens then disappears: BrowserWindow not retained (GC) + transparent config
